name: Exp_BlauCMI
summary: This EA trades based on the BlauCMI (Ergodic CMI) indicator, a momentum-based oscillator with triple smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator rises and sell positions when it falls, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于BlauCMI（ergodic CMI）指标进行交易，这是一个经过三重平滑的动量振荡器。当指标上升时开多仓，指标下降时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于William Blau的CMI（累积动量指标），通过对动量值进行三重平滑来过滤噪音，生成更稳定的交易信号。入场条件为：当指标值逐根上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓，当指标值逐根下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件包括固定点数的止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点），以及在反向信号出现时平仓（多仓在下降信号时平仓，空仓在上升信号时平仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持按存款比例或固定手数两种模式。资金管理使用MarginMode枚举来决定手数计算方式，MM默认0.1表示使用存款的10%。策略使用多周期设计，指标可在不同于图表的时间框架上运行，增强了灵活性。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on William Blau's CMI (Cumulative Momentum Index), which applies triple smoothing to momentum values to filter noise and generate more stable trading signals. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator value rises consecutively (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and a sell position opens when the indicator value falls consecutively (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions include fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), as well as closing positions on opposing signals (long positions close on a declining signal, short positions close on a rising signal). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting either deposit percentage or fixed lot size modes. Money management uses the MarginMode enumeration to determine lot calculation, with MM defaulting to 0.1 representing 10% of the deposit. The strategy employs a multi-timeframe design where the indicator can run on a different timeframe than the chart, enhancing flexibility.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易资金比例，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit percentage or fixed lots; negative value means lot size

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 三重平滑动量指标有效减少市场噪音，信号更稳定
支持多种平滑算法（EMA/JJMA/VIDIA/AMA），灵活适应不同市场
具备完整的止损止盈机制和双向交易开关控制
多时间框架设计允许在高时间框架分析、低时间框架执行
有输入参数验证（IPC1==IPC2且XLength==1时拒绝初始化）
pros_en: Triple smoothing effectively reduces market noise, producing more stable signals
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms (EMA/JJMA/VIDIA/AMA) for market adaptability
Complete stop loss/take profit mechanism with bidirectional trade toggle controls
Multi-timeframe design allows analysis on higher timeframes with execution on lower ones
Input parameter validation rejects invalid configurations (IPC1==IPC2 with XLength==1)
cons: 缺乏点差过滤，在点差较大时可能产生不利入场
没有追踪止损功能，可能无法充分保护浮动利润
止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未根据市场波动性自适应调整
指标参数众多（5个平滑深度+1个相位），过度优化风险高
未检查是否已有同向持仓，可能重复开仓
cons_en: No spread filter, potentially entering at unfavorable prices during wide spreads
No trailing stop feature, potentially failing to protect floating profits adequately
Fixed stop loss (1000pts) and take profit (2000pts) without ATR-based volatility adaptation
Numerous indicator parameters (5 smoothing depths + 1 phase) create high overfitting risk
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially opening duplicate trades
improvements: 添加ATR自适应止损止盈，根据市场波动性动态调整
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓和过度风险暴露
添加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，提高入场质量
improvements_en: Add ATR-based adaptive stop loss/take profit that dynamically adjusts to market volatility
Add position checking logic to avoid duplicate entries in the same direction and excessive risk exposure
Add spread filter and trading session filter to improve entry quality

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性，在高波动期可能频繁止损
无同向持仓检查，可能累积过多单方向风险敞口
参数过多存在过度拟合风险，回测表现可能无法在实盘中复现
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit ignores market volatility, potentially causing frequent stop outs during high volatility
No same-direction position check may accumulate excessive directional risk exposure
Excessive parameters create overfitting risk; backtest performance may not replicate in live trading
